name: Improbable Traverse
approach: From Alpental Ski Area parking lot (3,120 ft), walk through residential area on Ober Strasse Road to talus cone base beneath west face (note: as of 2021, private road access is contested; climbers must use new non-established approach avoiding Alpental Community Club private roads). Approach time ~30 minutes to 1 hour from parking.

waypoints.name: Alpental Ski Area / Snow Lake Trailhead parking lot
waypoints.note: Alpental Ski Area parking lot, the shared start for all Guye Peak routes, including Improbable Traverse via the Ober Strasse approach.
waypoints.directions: From I-90 Exit 52 (West Summit) at Snoqualmie Pass, turn north onto Alpental Road, pass under the freeway, keep right at the fork just beyond the Pacific Crest Trail access, and drive about 1.4 miles to the Alpental Ski Area lot, with the Snow Lake trailhead across the road. A Northwest Forest Pass is required. Do not drive or park on the private Strasse roads off the access road.

waypoints.name: Lunch Ledge belay (~300 ft on route)
Guye Peak summit (south summit, has the summit register; traverse endpoint)

beta: Start from Alpental parking lot and hike up talus cone via Ober Strasse Road (controversial private access; use new non-established approach avoiding private roads as of 2021). Scramble ~200 feet of loose, mossy, dirty slabs to reach first anchor. Climb 6 pitches of mixed alpine rock through crumbly terrain to Lunch Ledge at ~300 feet. The iconic traverse (pitches 4-5) traverses right on good ledges with old fixed pitons; now requires careful downclimbing due to 2021 damage. Upper pitches climb Class 4 ramp terrain with trees and exposure to summit. Route is sustained and exposed throughout; not a beginner alpine rock climb.
